questions.stem: \( 15 \) men can complete a work in \( 20 \) days. After working for \( 8 \) days, \( 5 \) men left the work. In how many more days will the remaining work be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 15 \times 20 = 300 \) man-days
Work done in \( 8 \) days = \( 15 \times 8 = 120 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 300 - 120 = 180 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 15 - 5 = 10 \) men
Time to complete remaining work = \( \frac{180}{10} = 18 \) days

questions.stem: \( 24 \) workers can finish a job in \( 30 \) days. After \( 12 \) days, \( 8 \) workers left the job. How many days will it take to complete the remaining work?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 24 \times 30 = 720 \) worker-days
Work completed in \( 12 \) days = \( 24 \times 12 = 288 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 720 - 288 = 432 \) worker-days
Remaining workers = \( 24 - 8 = 16 \) workers
Time needed = \( \frac{432}{16} = 27 \) days

questions.stem: A group of \( 20 \) men can complete a project in \( 25 \) days. After working for \( 10 \) days, \( 5 \) men leave the project. In how many additional days will the project be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 20 \times 25 = 500 \) man-days
Work done in \( 10 \) days = \( 20 \times 10 = 200 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 500 - 200 = 300 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 20 - 5 = 15 \) men
Additional days = \( \frac{300}{15} = 20 \) days

questions.stem: \( 18 \) women can complete a task in \( 16 \) days. After \( 6 \) days, \( 6 \) women left. How many more days are needed to complete the task?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 18 \times 16 = 288 \) woman-days
Work done in \( 6 \) days = \( 18 \times 6 = 108 \) woman-days
Remaining work = \( 288 - 108 = 180 \) woman-days
Remaining women = \( 18 - 6 = 12 \) women
Days needed = \( \frac{180}{12} = 15 \) days

questions.stem: A job can be completed by \( 30 \) men in \( 40 \) days. After \( 15 \) days of work, \( 10 \) men left the job. In how many days will the remaining men complete the job?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 30 \times 40 = 1200 \) man-days
Work done in \( 15 \) days = \( 30 \times 15 = 450 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 1200 - 450 = 750 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 30 - 10 = 20 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{750}{20} = 37.5 \) days

questions.stem: \( 36 \) workers can build a wall in \( 18 \) days. After \( 9 \) days, \( 12 \) workers leave. How many additional days will be required to build the remaining wall?
questions.keySolution:

Work done in \( 9 \) days = \( 36 \times 9 = 324 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 648 - 324 = 324 \) worker-days
Remaining workers = \( 36 - 12 = 24 \) workers
Additional days = \( \frac{324}{24} = 13.5 \) days

questions.stem: A construction project requires \( 25 \) men to work for \( 32 \) days. After \( 12 \) days, \( 8 \) men left due to illness. How many more days will it take to complete the project?

Work done in \( 12 \) days = \( 25 \times 12 = 300 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 800 - 300 = 500 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 25 - 8 = 17 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{500}{17} = 29.41 \) days

questions.stem: \( 42 \) men can dig a canal in \( 28 \) days. After \( 14 \) days, \( 14 \) men left the work. In how many days will the remaining work be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 42 \times 28 = 1176 \) man-days
Work done in \( 14 \) days = \( 42 \times 14 = 588 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 1176 - 588 = 588 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 42 - 14 = 28 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{588}{28} = 21 \) days

questions.stem: A, B and C can complete a work in \( 10 \), \( 12 \) and \( 15 \) days respectively. They start working together but A leaves after \( 3 \) days and B leaves \( 2 \) days before completion. If C completes the remaining work, find the total time taken.
questions.keySolution:
Work rates: A = \( \frac{1}{10} \), B = \( \frac{1}{12} \), C = \( \frac{1}{15} \) per day
Let total time be t days
Work done by A in first 3 days = \( 3 \times \frac{1}{10} = \frac{3}{10} \)
Work done by B in (t-2) days = \( (t-2) \times \frac{1}{12} \)
Work done by C in t days = \( t \times \frac{1}{15} \)
Total work equation: \( \frac{3}{10} + \frac{(t-2)}{12} + \frac{t}{15} = 1 \)
Solving: t = \( 7 \) days

questions.stem: \( 20 \) men working \( 8 \) hours a day can complete a work in \( 15 \) days. After \( 6 \) days, \( 5 \) men left. If the remaining men work \( 10 \) hours a day, in how many more days will the work be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 20 \times 8 \times 15 = 2400 \) man-hours
Work done in 6 days = \( 20 \times 8 \times 6 = 960 \) man-hours
Remaining work = \( 2400 - 960 = 1440 \) man-hours
Remaining men = \( 15 \) working \( 10 \) hours/day
Daily work capacity = \( 15 \times 10 = 150 \) man-hours
Days needed = \( \frac{1440}{150} = 9.6 \) days

questions.stem: A work can be completed by \( 16 \) men in \( 24 \) days. After working for \( 8 \) days, \( 4 \) men joined and \( 6 \) men left. In how many more days will the work be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 16 \times 24 = 384 \) man-days
Work done in 8 days = \( 16 \times 8 = 128 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 384 - 128 = 256 \) man-days
New workforce = \( 16 + 4 - 6 = 14 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{256}{14} = 18.29 \) days

questions.stem: \( 28 \) workers can finish a job in \( 21 \) days. After \( 7 \) days, some workers left and the remaining work was completed in \( 24 \) more days. How many workers left?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 28 \times 21 = 588 \) worker-days
Work done in 7 days = \( 28 \times 7 = 196 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 588 - 196 = 392 \) worker-days
Let x workers remained
Work done by remaining workers in 24 days = \( 392 \)
So \( x \times 24 = 392 \)
\( x = \frac{392}{24} = 16.33 ≈ 14 \) workers remained
Workers left = \( 28 - 14 = 14 \) workers

questions.stem: A contractor employed \( 35 \) men to complete a work in \( 40 \) days. After \( 16 \) days, he realized that only \( \frac{2}{5} \) of the work was completed. How many additional men should he employ to complete the work on time?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 35 \times 40 = 1400 \) man-days
Work completed = \( \frac{2}{5} \times 1400 = 560 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 1400 - 560 = 840 \) man-days
Remaining time = \( 40 - 16 = 24 \) days
Total men needed = \( \frac{840}{24} = 35 \) men
Additional men needed = \( 35 + 17.5 - 35 = 17.5 \) men

questions.stem: A project requires \( 45 \) people working for \( 30 \) days. After \( 12 \) days, \( 15 \) people left due to emergency. How many more days will be needed to complete the project?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 45 \times 30 = 1350 \) person-days
Work done in 12 days = \( 45 \times 12 = 540 \) person-days
Remaining work = \( 1350 - 540 = 810 \) person-days
Remaining people = \( 45 - 15 = 30 \) people
Days needed = \( \frac{810}{30} = 27 \) days

questions.stem: \( 32 \) men can complete a task in \( 18 \) days. After working for \( 6 \) days, \( 8 \) men left. After \( 4 \) more days, \( 6 \) additional men joined. In how many more days will the task be completed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 32 \times 18 = 576 \) man-days
Work done in first 6 days = \( 32 \times 6 = 192 \) man-days
Work done in next 4 days by 24 men = \( 24 \times 4 = 96 \) man-days
Total work done = \( 192 + 96 = 288 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 576 - 288 = 288 \) man-days
Current workforce = \( 24 + 6 = 30 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{288}{30} = 9.6 \) days

questions.stem: A work can be done by \( 22 \) men in \( 36 \) days. After \( 18 \) days, \( 6 \) men left and \( 4 \) new men joined. In how many days will the remaining work be finished?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 22 \times 36 = 792 \) man-days
Work done in 18 days = \( 22 \times 18 = 396 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 792 - 396 = 396 \) man-days
New workforce = \( 22 - 6 + 4 = 20 \) men
Days needed = \( \frac{396}{20} = 19.8 \) days

questions.stem: \( 18 \) skilled workers can complete a project in \( 25 \) days. After \( 10 \) days, \( 3 \) workers left and \( 6 \) semi-skilled workers (\( 75\% \) efficient) joined. How many more days to complete?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 18 \times 25 = 450 \) skilled-worker-days
Work done in 10 days = \( 18 \times 10 = 180 \) skilled-worker-days
Remaining work = \( 450 - 180 = 270 \) skilled-worker-days
Remaining skilled workers = \( 18 - 3 = 15 \)
Semi-skilled workers equivalent = \( 6 \times 0.75 = 4.5 \) skilled workers
Total equivalent workforce = \( 15 + 4.5 = 19.5 \) skilled workers
Days needed = \( \frac{270}{19.5} = 13.85 \) days

questions.stem: A group of \( 40 \) workers can build a bridge in \( 45 \) days. After \( 20 \) days, \( 10 \) workers got sick and left. How many additional days will be required?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 40 \times 45 = 1800 \) worker-days
Work done in 20 days = \( 40 \times 20 = 800 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 1800 - 800 = 1000 \) worker-days
Remaining workers = \( 40 - 10 = 30 \) workers
Additional days = \( \frac{1000}{30} = 33.33 \) days

questions.stem: A job requires \( 24 \) men working \( 6 \) hours daily for \( 20 \) days. After \( 12 \) days, \( 8 \) men left. If remaining men work \( 8 \) hours daily, how many more days needed?

Remaining work = \( 2880 - 1728 = 1152 \) man-hours
Remaining men = \( 24 - 8 = 16 \) men working \( 8 \) hours daily
Daily work capacity = \( 16 \times 8 = 128 \) man-hours
Days needed = \( \frac{1152}{128} = 9 \) days

questions.stem: \( 30 \) workers working \( 7 \) hours a day complete a work in \( 18 \) days. After \( 6 \) days, \( 10 \) workers leave and remaining work \( 9 \) hours a day. Find additional days needed.

Remaining work = \( 3780 - 1260 = 2520 \) worker-hours
Remaining workers = \( 30 - 10 = 20 \) working \( 9 \) hours daily
Daily work capacity = \( 20 \times 9 = 180 \) worker-hours
Days needed = \( \frac{2520}{180} = 14 \) days

questions.stem: A contractor has \( 26 \) men to complete a building in \( 42 \) days. After \( 14 \) days, \( 8 \) men were transferred to another project. In how many more days will the building be completed?

Work done in 14 days = \( 26 \times 14 = 364 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 1092 - 364 = 728 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 26 - 8 = 18 \) men

questions.stem: A work needs \( 48 \) laborers for \( 15 \) days. After \( 5 \) days, \( 16 \) laborers left and \( 8 \) new laborers joined. How many more days will be required?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 48 \times 15 = 720 \) laborer-days
Work done in 5 days = \( 48 \times 5 = 240 \) laborer-days
Remaining work = \( 720 - 240 = 480 \) laborer-days
New workforce = \( 48 - 16 + 8 = 40 \) laborers
Days needed = \( \frac{480}{40} = 12 \) days

questions.stem: \( 54 \) men can complete a task in \( 16 \) days. After \( 8 \) days, due to shortage of materials, \( 18 \) men had to be sent away. How many additional days will be needed?

Work done in 8 days = \( 54 \times 8 = 432 \) man-days
Remaining work = \( 864 - 432 = 432 \) man-days
Remaining men = \( 54 - 18 = 36 \) men

questions.stem: A project can be completed by \( 35 \) engineers in \( 28 \) days. After \( 12 \) days of work, \( 7 \) engineers left and \( 14 \) junior engineers (\( 60\% \) efficient) joined. How many more days needed?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 35 \times 28 = 980 \) engineer-days
Work done in 12 days = \( 35 \times 12 = 420 \) engineer-days
Remaining work = \( 980 - 420 = 560 \) engineer-days
Remaining senior engineers = \( 35 - 7 = 28 \)
Junior engineers equivalent = \( 14 \times 0.6 = 8.4 \) senior engineers
Total equivalent workforce = \( 28 + 8.4 = 36.4 \) senior engineers
Days needed = \( \frac{560}{36.4} = 15.38 \) days

questions.stem: \( 60 \) workers are employed to finish a work in \( 20 \) days. After \( 8 \) days, the contractor finds that only \( \frac{1}{3} \) of work is done. How many more workers should be added to complete work on time?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 60 \times 20 = 1200 \) worker-days
Work completed = \( \frac{1}{3} \times 1200 = 400 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 1200 - 400 = 800 \) worker-days
Remaining time = \( 20 - 8 = 12 \) days
Workers needed = \( \frac{800}{12} = 66.67 ≈ 67 \) workers
Additional workers needed = \( 67 - 60 = 7 \) workers

questions.stem: A manufacturing unit employs \( 45 \) workers to complete an order in \( 32 \) days. After \( 16 \) days, \( 15 \) workers resigned. How many days will it take to complete the remaining work?
questions.keySolution:
Total work = \( 45 \times 32 = 1440 \) worker-days
Work done in 16 days = \( 45 \times 16 = 720 \) worker-days
Remaining work = \( 1440 - 720 = 720 \) worker-days
Remaining workers = \( 45 - 15 = 30 \) workers
Days needed = \( \frac{720}{30} = 24 \) days
